cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: stronger primary anionic Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate #2 substantially buffered by Cocamide MEA #3, Glycerin #4, Cocamidopropyl Betaine #5, Coco-Betaine #17 and refatting PEG-55 Propylene Glycol Oleate #12; the second anionic Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate #7 is a mild amino-acid surfactant, not a reset route.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Two anionic routes could be read as reinforcing (strong).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several routes - Glycerin #4, pearlizer Glycol Distearate #6, Butyrospermum Parkii Butter #10, Sodium Hyaluronate #14, late cationic polymers Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #19 and Polyquaternium-7 #21. No silicone; cationics late.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Butter + pearlizer + two cationics + humectants could be read as high.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: lipid (shea butter #10) and cationic polymers (#19, #21) are after Parfum #8; pearlizer and humectants are light; effective olefin-sulfonate base.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Late lipid and polymers; light routes.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Interacting lighter routes are the realistic path to moderate, recorded as neighbor.
weightPotential.counterSignal: Shea butter is a persistent payload lipid.

focusPrimary.rationale: Moisture: 'Feuchtigkeitsauffüllendes' in name, '5 % Feuchtigkeitskomplex mit Hyaluron und Shea-Fettsäuren', 'bis zu 72 Stunden Feuchtigkeit'; verdict moisture_supported via prominent Glycerin #4 plus Sodium Hyaluronate #14, Propylene Glycol #18 and emollient/deposition support (shea #10, pearlizer #6, guar #19, PQ-7 #21) (F1). Curl definition is hair_texture, not a focus.

careDirection.limitation: '5 %' is a claim, not a proven concentration; rinse-off.

focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind: prominent glycerin + emollient/cationic support -> moisture_supported. Unblind: moisture in name -> moisture.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: 'gebändigte/definierte Locken' is a texture outcome of the same deposition route (F2); no other distinct positioning.

usageRole.rationale: Regular: no daily/frequent, reset or treatment trigger.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No scalp-comfort positioning (directions apply to the scalp but make no claim).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; Salicylic Acid #23 alone does not count.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low, C moderate: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable. T2: curls/'lockiges Haar' ignored. T4: W neighbor moderate would make fine acceptable -> review_thickness_boundary (fine); C neighbor high would raise coarse (no flag).
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: moderate -> regular. I3: neighbor strong would also give regular (no clarifying focus) -> no flag.
projection.liveComparison: Not evaluated (live rows not in sealed packet).

uncertainties: Moisture claimed for curly hair with weight low/moderate on the boundary: T4 flags fine because a moderate-confidence W low necessarily names moderate as neighbor.
C1 is written for ether sulfates; olefin sulfonate + sarcosinate + betaine resolved via the moderate anchor.
